indicator: Confirmed elective recovery envelope for the ICB, 18 months to Sep-2027
source: NOT IN WAREHOUSE — NHS England allocation and planning guidance; ICB finance ledger
action: Re-run the grid at the confirmed envelope. This is the highest-impact uncertainty in the model and the only one with no internal data source, so it must be tracked through the finance route rather than the analytics one.

indicator: DM01 diagnostic tests per completed RTT pathway, 12 core trusts, monthly
trigger: Sustained rise above 2.00 for three consecutive months triggers review; 3.34 is the point at which the optimal strategy changes shape entirely
action: Above the tipping point the diagnostic lever is no longer the cheapest route to a cleared pathway and the programme should shift to treatment capacity. The observed proxy currently sits well below both thresholds.

indicator: Share of the DM01 diagnostic waiting list waiting over six weeks
current_value: 10.2% mean over the last 12 months, against 8.1% over the preceding 12
trigger: A statistically significant upward trend sustained over two quarters, or the 12-month mean exceeding 15%
action: The model assumes 10% headroom for additional diagnostic activity, so a deteriorating diagnostic waiting list would undercut the recommended strategy at source. Read the level, not the last data point: over the full window the series trends significantly DOWNWARD (-0.001 points per month, p=0.009), and over the last 24 months there is no significant trend either way (p=0.21) on a series with a standard deviation of about 2 points. The 12-month mean has stepped up by roughly 2 points, which is worth watching but is not evidence of deterioration.
status: ACTIVE — measurable monthly; currently a level shift, not a trend

indicator: ICB total RTT waiting list against the Monte Carlo forecast band
trigger: Actual outside the p5–p95 band for two consecutive months
action: Recalibrate the forecast. Note that backlog size has no effect on the optimal allocation at any funding level in scope — the budget clears far less than the backlog either way — so this flag governs the credibility of the stated ambition, not the choice of strategy.
status: ACTIVE — monitoring only, does not change the strategy

indicator: Independent-sector NHS-funded completed pathways, trailing six-month mean
action: The independent-sector capacity ceiling does not bind until the envelope exceeds £31.9m, above the top of the scenario range. Monitoring is not warranted at current funding levels and is recorded here so that the omission is deliberate rather than overlooked.
status: DORMANT — outside the range in which it can bind
